remotion_captions.text: How many hours do you lose posting the same property on five different portals?
If you run a real estate agency, I need seven minutes of your time.
I'm building a system for real estate agencies, and I want you to design it.
I'm Jesús, a software developer in Medellín, Colombia.
Before I build it, I want to know what agencies really need, day to day.
What would save you the most time? Managing listings and clients,
publishing to portals, collecting rent, or replying on WhatsApp automatically.
So I made a short survey. It takes about seven minutes.
Everyone who answers gets to try it for free.
And the first founding clients get a lifetime discount and every feature.
The link is in the description. Thanks for helping me build it.
